reason: When I don't know a dish I call my mum or watch a free YouTube video, and that already works for my Sunday cooking. 99 baht isn't much, but I don't see why I'd pay an app for what mum tells me for nothing.
objection: Why pay when free videos and my mum already show me how? And I doubt an app's green curry will taste like the one I grew up with.
would_change_my_mind: If my mum or a friend I trust used it and told me the Sunday cook-ahead plan really saved them time and money, I'd try it.
